title: Chapter 764 Change; Devour!
content:
Chapter 764 Change; Devour!

Chapter 764 Change; Devour!

Lin Fan quickly turned his attention to the system panel.

[Subhuti: Cultivation base unknown. Because you cursed Tai Ba and Bo Han to death, and then shifted the blame to Pu Guo, from then on, hatred was generated towards you. Current Hatred Points: 2 stars.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan's heart skipped a beat.

Cultivation unknown!

As expected of a character from a fairy tale.

So, the Holy Master wasn't the cultivator with the highest cultivation?

Lin Fan's heart skipped a beat,'Does Subhuti know that I'm the one who did this?"

[Requires 1 billion spirit stones. Do you want to ask?]

One billion Spiritual Stones!

To many people, this was an astronomical figure.

However, to Lin Fan, it was nothing.

This was because after several hundred years of accumulation, his Spirit Stones, Immortal Crystals, and even Saint Crystals had become extremely abundant.

One billion spirit stones was just a drop in the ocean for Lin Fan.

Therefore, Lin Fan did not hesitate at all and said,""Inquire!"

[Subhuti only hates everyone behind the scenes. He doesn't know that the host is the mastermind.]

When Lin Fan heard that, he heaved a sigh of relief.

"If I were to fight Subhuti head-on, how long could I last?"

[Requires 1 billion spirit stones. Do you wish to inquire?]

"Yes, sir!" Lin Fan said.

[1 year.]

Lin Fan was even more flustered.

One year, he could only resist the Bodhi Fruit for one year.

This was simply too terrifying.

Danger!

A huge sense of danger surged up like a tide.

Hu Tian also noticed the change in Lin Fan and couldn't help but ask,"" Lin Fan, what's wrong?"

Lin Fan said," Next, I might need to go into seclusion for a period of time. You guys can take a look around first.""

Time waits for no man.

After saying that, Lin Fan's body flashed and he flew straight into the cultivation room. He quickly entered his cultivation state.

Only Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others were left looking at each other.

Not long after, they also began to cultivate.

Even though Lin Fan didn't say much.

However, they knew that something must have happened.

The only thing they could do was to keep up with Lin Fan.

This way, when something happened, he could lend Lin Fan a helping hand.

At the very least, he couldn't be a burden.

....

Cultivation was timeless.

In the blink of an eye, 50 years had passed.

During these 50 years, the various universes were very peaceful and quiet.

However, those who were observant could vaguely smell something unusual from it.

It was like the calm before the storm.

"Boom!"

"Boom!"

On this day, loud noises suddenly sounded on many planets.

Then, a huge lotus flower appeared in the air.

Then, everyone on the planet sat cross-legged and chanted the name of Buddha.

Not long after, black demonic qi appeared on many planets. All the living beings became extremely crazy and turned into demons.

Some planets were suddenly covered by seawater, and countless creatures grew fish scales and fish tails.

There were also some planets that had flames on the surface, turning into fireballs.

....

The structure of the universe was rapidly changing.

The weak forces 'territories were constantly decreasing or even completely disappearing.

The big fish ate the small fish, and the small fish ate the shrimp.

As one of the small fish, the Longhu Sect was in a predicament like many small forces.

"Buddha, demon, fire, sea, and other worlds are all expanding crazily."

"The Buddha Realm has already expressed their interest in us a while ago."

"It's not just the Buddha Realm. The Demon Realm, Fire Realm, and Ocean Realm have long sent people over."

"Sigh…"

Sighs rose and fell in the Longhu Sect.

Qin Qiuliang clenched his fists, his heart filled with anger.

He grew up in the Dragon Gate Sect and wanted to become a powerhouse so that he could lead the Dragon Tiger Sect to greater heights.

In the end, he had not become strong enough.

Now, the Dragon Tiger Sect was threatened by many forces.

Moreover, this was the second time!

The first attack came from the ocean universe.

Now, it was being devoured by many worlds.

These... He actually couldn't stop it.

If only he could be stronger…

If only he could be like Lin Fan…

Then, the Dragon Tiger Sect would definitely not be like this.

As Qin Qiuliang thought of this, the blood in his body began to boil violently.

He did not notice that the jade pendant hanging around his neck had turned red and bright.

Then, a powerful suction force was produced, directly sucking him into an unknown space.

Ten years later, Qin Qiuliang finally appeared in the Longhu Sect.

A dark-skinned middle-aged man appeared beside him.

Their bodies were all filled with incomparably powerful auras.

Qin Qiuliang pulled a man who was walking in a hurry and said,""Hu Tao!"

The man named Hu Tao paused in his steps.

When he saw who it was, he replied,"Qiu Liang? Why are you still here?"

Ten years ago, Qin Qiuliang's sudden disappearance did not attract too much attention.

Because, in the eyes of cultivators, 10 years was just the blink of an eye.

Qin Qiuliang didn't explain anything and said,""How is the sect? Did something happen?"

"Someone from the Ocean World has come. They said that if we don't surrender today, the Dragon Tiger Sect will disappear completely."Hu Tao sighed." Right now, the sect master and elders are about to hold a disciple meeting."

When Qin Qiuliang heard this, he raised his eyebrows and said in a deep voice,""If you don't surrender, you want the Dragon Tiger Sect to disappear? What an arrogant tone!"

As soon as he finished speaking, he and the dark-skinned man beside him disappeared together.

Hu Tao called out twice, but there was no response.

He could only mutter to himself, Where has Qiu Liang been during this period of time? There seems to be a strong sense of oppression on his body..."

"Also, who is the person beside him? I don't think I've seen him before."

....

Qin Qiuliang was completely unaware of Hu Tao's doubts.

If he knew, he wouldn't have explained anything.

Of course, he would not tell them that he had entered the Ancient Desolate Space for the past 10 years. One day there was equivalent to 100 years in the outside world.

In other words, he had stayed in the ancient desolate space for 360,000 years!

The ancient desolate space contained extremely pure energy and countless opportunities.

Now, Qin Qiuliang's cultivation had already stepped into the Holy Lord realm. Moreover, he was an expert among the Holy Lords and had become a legendary great existence in this universe.

Not only him, but the dark-skinned man beside him was also a Holy Lord!

Two Sacred Lords could solve many problems.

"Whoosh!"

In the next moment, Qin Qiuliang and the dark-skinned man appeared at the disciples 'meeting together.

Their appearance did not attract too much attention.

It was also at this moment that the old sect master, who was sitting at the top, slowly opened his mouth.

"The Longhu Sect has been established for a million years. It has been glorious, depressed, and fallen…"

His pale eyes scanned the scene, and his voice was hoarse and reluctant.
